nodes.name: RecipeRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Data-driven event renderer component that resolves a tool's uiCanonical and action name from raw event props, looks up the corresponding ChatBlock from the Rust tool registry, and dispatches rendering to the matching Block component.
nodes.languageNotes: Adding a new tool that reuses an existing Block requires zero frontend changes; only Rust's tool registry needs to set chat_block.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting all chat block adapter components (ReadFileAdapter, ShellAdapter, OrgTaskAdapter, DiffAdapter, etc.) that wrap Block components with pre-translated labels from the Rust tool registry.

nodes.name: chatBlocks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines CHAT_BLOCKS, a lookup map from each ChatBlock variant (read_file, diff, shell, org_task, etc.) to its adapter component, plus a FALLBACK_BLOCK and a hidden-block sentinel, used by RecipeRenderer to select which Block to render.

nodes.name: extractActualToolName
nodes.summary: Resolves the actual tool/function name from raw event props by checking functionName, nested event.functionName, and function fields in priority order, falling back to the generic 'tool_call' sentinel.

nodes.name: extractAction
nodes.summary: Derives the action name for a normalized event, first via deriveToolAction, then falling back to matching an '[action: x]' marker in the result output or content string.

nodes.name: RecipeRenderer
nodes.summary: React functional component that normalizes raw event props, resolves the uiCanonical/tool/action combination, looks up the matching ChatBlock via getActionChatBlock with fallbacks, and renders the resolved Block component.
